title: Emmett Hardy: his playing, fingers and tone, where he worked
summary: Love knew Hardy from meeting on the ferry but never played with him; Hardy was fast, sweet-toned and used artificial fingers. A record is played and discussed, then Hardy's jobs across the river.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
